executor: Codex-assisted implementation, source inspection and automated checks

checks.label: Friends with same-name contacts beyond the directory window

privacy.scope: Local Auth/Firestore emulator workflow with fictional verified accounts. UI text/labels/search privacy and correct recipient delivery; internal IDs remain in client/server data.

behavior: Post/comment, Friends/request/shortcut, conversation and own Profile screens no longer render raw account IDs.
Public identity labels and name/college search ignore internal IDs and email fields.
Friend notifications open Friends without inserting an actor ID into the search input.
Known contacts still resolve outside the first-100 directory; arbitrary ID-driven profile lookup is removed. New people discovery retains the bounded directory scope.
Different colleges/photos distinguish the same-name fixtures; existing connection IDs still deliver to the correct participant.
privacyBoundary: UI metadata minimization, not anonymization or a new server identity layer. Internal IDs remain in authenticated Firebase responses/document paths and existing asset/request data. Rules, provider settings, billing and data schemas are unchanged.
verificationNotes: Successful checks are retained across initial and resumed runs; this is not a claim that all suites passed on the first attempt.
A stale notification fixture omitted required reviewer publication details. The fixture now supplies date/time/location explicitly; the complete notification workflow passed afterward.
The old photo workflow expected shared attachments to be disabled; its assertion was aligned with the existing enabled Photos action. No upload feature was added.
A previously occupied emulator port was avoided. The last Feed workflow used installed Chrome because the separate Playwright headless executable was absent.
All application code stayed unchanged while completing these fixture/environment corrections. Passed checks were not repeated without a new concern.

repeat.setup: Use an isolated demo-campusvibe-feed Auth/Firestore emulator and a localhost Vite server. Set VITE_FIREBASE_EMULATORS=true and the matching VITE/auth/Firestore emulator ports. Set ACCOUNT_TEST_URL and FEED_TEST_URL to the localhost server; direct CAMPUS_TEST_ARTIFACTS_URL to a temporary output folder. The legacy shared-feed script accepts PLAYWRIGHT_CHROME_PATH for installed Chrome.

limits: Signed-in validation uses fictional verified emulator accounts and generated thumbnails, not production users or independent human testers.
No production authenticated data read/write, provider upload, verification email or Google login is certified.
Read-only deployed guest/asset readiness is recorded separately on Issue #172.
preservation: All backend, docs, README and .github files are unchanged; no application dependencies were added.
